description: This PHP class 'EmployeeReportingMethodService' provides methods to fetch employee supervisor and subordinate data from the database, utilizing DAO (Data Access Object). It includes typical getter/setter methods, search functions, and list manipulation utilities, serving as a service layer within the OrangeHRM application.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodService
classes.description: Service class for managing employee reporting relationships such as supervisors and subordinates within OrangeHRM, utilizing DAO for database interactions and providing list utilities.

methods.name: getEmployeeReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Lazy-loads and returns the EmployeeReportingMethodDao instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO instance, typically for dependency injection.

methods.name: getImmediateSupervisorListForEmployee
methods.description: Fetches a list of immediate supervisors for a given employee based on search parameters.

methods.name: getImmediateSupervisorListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Returns the count of immediate supervisors matching the search parameters.

methods.name: getSubordinateListForEmployee
methods.description: Fetches a list of subordinates for a given employee based on search parameters.

methods.name: getSubordinateListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Returns the count of subordinates matching the search parameters.

methods.name: getAccessibleAndAvailableSupervisorsIdCombinedList
methods.description: Returns a list of supervisor IDs that are accessible and not yet assigned.

methods.name: getAlreadyAssignedSupervisorsSubordinatesAndSelfIdCombinedList
methods.description: Combines supervisor IDs, subordinate IDs, and the employee's own ID into a single list.
